integrity: Analytic Banach-contraction and symbolic-factor proof with finite high-precision auxiliary diagnostics; standard factor-entropy theorem used.
scientific_limitations: Compact forward-invariant subsystems lie in the nonsingular region. The entropy is a supremum over compact continuous subsystems, not a global compact-space entropy. No statistical, security, or finite-precision inference. No independent mathematical audit.
title: Unbounded compact symbolic entropy in a coupled reciprocal-sine map
